body:
Fixes the `BoundsError` currently failing both `test/grids.jl` and the docs build on every fresh CI.

## Cause

ClimaCore [v0.15.0](https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaCore.jl/releases/tag/v0.15.0) replaced every `Field` with a unified `VIJHWithF` layout. From its release notes:

> Replaced all `Field` values with a unified `VIJHWithF` layout type. Data is now indexed in the order `[v, i, j, h]`, and **every parent array has a 5-dimensional shape**. For backward compatibility, `[i, j, f, v, h]` `DataLayout` indexing is still allowed, but **downstream code that indexes directly into `parent(field)` arrays needs to be updated.**

Two places read the horizontal grid's coordinates through `parent(...)` and hard-coded the old 4-dimensional `IJFH` shape as `[1, 1, 1, :]`. Under the new layout the array is `1×2×2×1×18`, and four indices no longer cover five dimensions:

```
BoundsError: attempt to access 1×2×2×1×18 view(::Array{Float64, 5}, :, :, :, 1:1, :)
             with eltype Float64 at index [1, 1, 1, 1:1]
```

This breaks the `BoxGrid` unit test and the `@setup` block that draws the space-filling curve in `docs/src/grids.md`.

## Why now, and why `main` passed CI

`Project.toml` already allowed `ClimaCore = "0.14.55, 0.15"`, but 0.15 was unreachable while no released `ClimaDiagnostics` supported it. `ClimaDiagnostics` v0.3.8 changed that, so any CI run resolving fresh from now on picks up ClimaCore 0.15. 

## Fix

Take the first index of each leading dimension rather than hard-coding how many there are:

```julia
first_node(p) = p[ntuple(_ -> 1, ndims(p) - 1)..., :]
```

`Nh` is the last dimension in both the old and new layouts, so this selects the first node of every element either way, and the code works whether an environment resolves ClimaCore 0.14.55 or 0.15.
title: Index parent arrays by rank, for ClimaCore 0.15 layouts

body:
This PR makes the model use non-constant rain sedimentation velocity by default. There is an assumed minimum velocity of about 0.8 m/s to allow for stable computation with 1 Newton iteration. 

In the same PR I also switch on the lateral mixing of precipitation in the updrafts where area fraction decreases with height.
title: Use non-constant rain sedimentation velocity
